factual_objections.claim: At Socialcam, when it reached number two in the App Store, the deck barely mattered.
factual_objections.evidence: The packet describes Socialcam as hot and supports the broader point that decks do not drive fundraising, but it does not establish a number-two App Store ranking.
factual_objections.label: unverified

factual_objections.claim: After roughly eight months of unsuccessful fundraising, the team had about two months of runway left.
factual_objections.evidence: The packet establishes eight months of fundraising followed by two productive months focused on profitability during a near-failure episode. It does not explicitly establish that exactly two months of runway remained.
factual_objections.label: unverified

verdict.reason: A better explains leverage, building a company investors chase, and prolonged investor interest as an option purchased with the founder's time. B captures the broad business-first advice and ability to continue without funding, but gives less of the underlying fundraising mechanism. A includes two historical specifics the packet does not establish.
